message.content: {"caption":"Two stacked bar-chart panels compare token reduction and average prompt-token counts across four AgeMem configurations for two language-model backbones.","description":"A two-panel grouped bar chart uses blue bars for Qwen2.5-7B and mauve bars for Qwen3-4B. The categories, left to right, are AgeMem-noRL -RAG, AgeMem -noRL, AgeMem -RAG, and AgeMem (Ours); the final category is highlighted with a pale yellow background. In the upper panel, the vertical axis is Token Reduction (%) with ticks from 0 to 6. The paired printed values by category (blue, mauve) are 2.6%, 2.6%; 4.3%, 3.0%; 0.0%, 0.0%; and 3.1%, 5.1%. A red dashed horizontal line marks zero and is annotated “Baseline: AgeMem-RAG.” In the lower panel, the vertical axis is Avg. Tokens, with a truncated scale starting at 2000 and a tick at 2250. The printed values by category (blue, mauve) are 2128, 2251; 2092, 2241; 2186, 2310; and 2117, 2191. Qwen3-4B has the higher average token count in all four categories; token reductions are equal for the first category, higher for Qwen2.5-7B in the second, zero for both in the third, and higher for Qwen3-4B in the final category.
